verdict.rationale: Capacities documents a public REST API for accessing, creating and manipulating content, including objects, properties, blocks and daily notes. It uses Bearer-token auth, publishes an OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec at api.capacities.io with an interactive try-it reference, and offers a TypeScript SDK plus documented rate limits. The probe 404s were on the docs domain, not api.capacities.io, so they do not contradict the published spec. The Beta API sunsets on September 1, 2026, with a documented successor portal. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the API works as documented; continuity is also less certain while integrations migrate between API generations.
